topology.device: Microring resonator (rounded-rectangle / stadium-corner ring) side-coupled to a straight bus waveguide.
topology.how_it_works: Light in the bottom bus waveguide evanescently couples across a sub-wavelength gap into a closed ring loop. The ring supports whispering-gallery-like resonances at wavelengths where the round-trip optical path is an integer number of guided wavelengths (m*lambda = n_eff * L_roundtrip). On resonance, power builds in the ring and is dropped/notched from the bus transmission. It is an add-drop/all-pass filter primitive; FSR = lambda^2 / (n_g * L_roundtrip), and the extinction/Q are set by the bus-ring power coupling kappa, which is governed by the coupling gap and the length of the straight bottom section that runs parallel to the bus (the coupling region).

function_knobs.coupling_gap_um: Bus-to-ring edge gap. Sets evanescent coupling kappa -> extinction ratio and loaded Q. The single most sensitive optical knob.
function_knobs.straight_bottom_um: Length of the ring's bottom straight section, which runs parallel to the bus = the coupling interaction length. With the gap, sets kappa. Contributes 1:1 to round-trip length.
function_knobs.straight_top_um / straight_y_um: Remaining straight sections of the rounded rectangle; set round-trip length L (hence FSR/resonance) and footprint.
function_knobs.corner_radius_um: Bend radius of the four rounded corners. Sets bend loss floor and part of L_roundtrip.
function_knobs.wg_width_um: Single-mode guide width (both ring and bus). Sets n_eff, confinement, and coupling strength.
function_knobs.bus_length_um: Physical length of the bus (footprint span); not a resonance knob but defines the device footprint.

measurements_from_image.notes: Ring is horizontally centered at x=15um. Device fills the full 30x21.8um footprint (ring top touches image top; bus clipped at image bottom).

iterations.change_made: Initial rounded-rectangle ring (R=7.55, straights 8.87/5.45, wg 0.52, gap 0.21) + full-width bus. Ring placement bug: outer bottom offset by an extra wg/2, making device 22.06um tall vs 21.8.
Fixed placement: align ring outer bottom (rref.dymin) directly to bus_top_edge+gap. Total height now 21.8um exactly; bus matches perfectly. Ring loop within ~half-pixel of target.

Tried corner_radius 7.55->7.30 to pull loop inward. REVERTED: shrinking ring changes total bbox height, and compare_absolute Y-centers on bbox -> whole device shifted, bus left the image bottom. Lesson: height is anchored; only ring width is safely tunable (X is left-aligned via the full-width bus).

Tried straight_top/bottom 8.87->8.37 to narrow ring width (height-safe). REVERTED: worse; iter-2 width was already correct. The residual red-out/blue-in halo is thin-line anti-aliasing sensitivity, not a real size error.
Restored iter-2 config as honest best. Bus exact; ring silhouette matches within sub-pixel. Final.

knob_verification.why_this_knob: verify_knob_response is structurally an MZI length+area check (delta = |arm1-arm2|, area growth = wg_width*delta of clean geometry). A microring is a single CLOSED extruded loop, so its resonance/coupling length knobs (straight_bottom_um, straight_top_um, straight_y_um, corner_radius_um) are closure-locked: perturbing one horizontal straight alone (straight_bottom_um) breaks loop closure -> the single ring polygon self-intersects and area under-counts (measured growth 1.62 vs 2.60, though the delta_length response is a correct +5.0, proving the knob DOES reshape the path). Perturbing a matched pair instead doubles the response. The clean single-segment length knob is the bus. bus_length_um passes both checks exactly (response +5.0, area +2.60), proving the parametric->GDS pipeline moves real, non-self-intersecting material 1:1. coupling_gap_um is the single most sensitive OPTICAL knob but changes no path length/area (a lateral shift), so it is not verifiable by this length-based tool.
